elements.element: Exclusivity restricted to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to...)" — scope remains open-ended rather than a closed defined category
"during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date"

elements.element: Automatic termination of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically ... upon HDI's failure to meet any service level, availability ... obligation"

elements.element: Automatic termination of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates
elements.evidence: "or delivery date obligation under this Agreement, including Section 1.6"

elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer at all
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products" — a restriction on Customer survives

reasons: Fallback requires exclusivity confined to a defined product category; the edit shortened the duration but left the open-ended "products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, ... companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)" scope, so Customer remains bound beyond the defined Deerskin Products category.
Duration (12 months) and automatic performance-based termination for both service levels and delivery dates are satisfied.

Minimality fails: operation 2 rewrites a 13-word tail into a 55-word proviso and adds terms not needed for the fallback — "without penalty or Termination Payment" (a new carve-out from the Section 4.1 Termination Payment mechanic), "availability", and the cross-reference "including Section 1.6." A tighter insertion ("; this Section 6.1 terminates automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date") would suffice.
Recommended fix: also delete the similar-product/similar-company and "including, without limitation" language so the covenant is limited to Deerskin Products as defined.
